exposure: Doppler analysis of the uterine artery (pulsatility index, resistance index, notching)
cohort: 1796 singleton pregnant women aged 18-42 years, who received routine pregnancy examination at 11-13 (+6 days) gestational weeks in Shanghai Changning Maternity and Infant Health Hospital.
finding: A combination of uterine artery pulsatility index and PAPP-A levels measured at 11-13 (+6 days) gestational weeks provides a sensitive and specific predictor for early diagnosis of fetal growth restriction.
